notes: Most defects are mechanical Arabic glitches from the source export: U+200F (RLM) used in place of a space between words, tatweel (ـ) stuck inside words, missing or stray spaces, and doubled kasra after اللّه. English side often drops apostrophes ('Allahs', 'Ones', 'People s'), has double spaces where dashes were lost, and in two records a broken 'Im?m'/'ImÁm'. Serious structural faults were rare but real: English from a neighbouring narration (misaligned x3), a narration's body pasted into chapter_ar (id 3743), and wrong speaker names in the Arabic or English prefix (several Ghurar al-Hikam records and 2105, 4360). Edits proposed only where they fit the allowed classes; invisible RLM-adjacent and apostrophe issues were mostly not flagged unless they joined words.
